trailhead.label: The car park at Caslino d’Erba station, the published start

cautions: A crossing of the SP 40 provincial road: keep your dog on a short lead.
Steep descents and long flights of steps.
The Piot and the Lambro: keep your dog out of the water near the weirs.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
